units.rawText: Banxsy, you seem to be in a great mood today! But I just got a complaint about someone vandalizing the walls in the business district. Would you happen to know anything about that?

units.rawText: Err... hahaha, I have no idea who did it, but I'd say it's a piece of art brimming with virtuosity.

units.rawText: My memory currently fails me, but I recall you being quite a serious Doll when you first joined the Exiles, Banxsy.

units.rawText: That's because in the beginning, there was no room for me to create anything in the Oasis. It was all empty, and I felt no spark of interest. Street art isn't just art for the sake of it—it's about how it harmonizes with the environment around it.

units.rawText: Moreover, I had been hunted by the Sanctifiers for several months, and I used all of my spray paints. No time, no space, no materials, all I had left was myself.

units.rawText: But it's so different now. The Oasis may not be the big city I once knew, but it's grown its own streets and culture, giving me a space to express my soul as a creator. Hmph-hmph-hmph, how about I make a new piece of art for your HQ, Professor?

units.rawText: Is this your way of saying that you approve of the Oasis I built?

units.rawText: Hmph, you can take it that way. Here, humans and agents share the same convictions, and same dreams... It's a great place, but just lacks a few things to become perfect.

units.rawText: What the Oasis still lacks is an art piece that truly represents it. Once I'm back in the real world, I'll create a work that transcends the Cloud and reality, bridging them together. Only art on that scale could do justice to the journey we've experienced.

units.rawText: But, fine. I'll rein in my creative thirst to some extent, then unleash it fully when you're ready to bring us out of the Cloud. Until then, let me aid you in battle. I've got my spray cans ready, and I guarantee they'll surprise any opponent!
